pfaff-olinger-gardens.st: In July 1896 the garden had a Ferris wheel; a boy fell from it and broke his leg (Eau Claire Leader, 5 Jul 1896, p. 5). The Leader mentions Olinger's garden about 428 times from 1875 to 1919, so it drew crowds for over 40 years.
src: Eau Claire Leader, 5 Jul 1896, p. 5 (newspapers.com image 239414122)

ld-sacred-heart-hospital.st: In the 1890s the hospital grounds were also used as "Hospital Park" for the Sacred Heart picnic (Eau Claire Leader, 5 Jul 1896, p. 5).
src: Eau Claire Leader, 5 Jul 1896, p. 5 (newspapers.com image 239414122)
